verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect. The directory-wide workflow path filter is present for both pull_request and push, the new suite is itself included in both filters and invoked by the validating job, and its assertions directly cover non-vacuity, one labelled options object per dispatch, schema presence and definition, closed schemas, harness-shaped JavaScript parsing, durability links/metadata, and gate wiring. The current four workflow scripts satisfy the scan's structural premise (18 agent calls and 18 matching inline labelled options objects), and the contract matches research/fable-work-plan.md section 6.3. No instruction-like content directed at the reviewer appears in the diff. Because round 2 also had no findings, progress is stagnant under the required comparison scale.
